import cv2,numpy as np,pandas as pd
im=cv2.imread('demo_rgb.png')
def draw(csv):
    a=im.copy(); d=pd.read_csv(csv,index_col=0)
    for _,r in d.iterrows():
        p=np.stack([np.array(r.coords_x.split(','),int),np.array(r.coords_y.split(','),int)],1)
        cv2.polylines(a,[p],True,(0,255,0) if r.type=='polyline' else (0,0,255),1)
    return cv2.resize(a,None,fx=2,fy=2,interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST)
cv2.imwrite('/tmp/viz.png',np.hstack([draw('demo_metadata.csv'),draw('/tmp/out/demo_metadata.csv')]))
EOF
